name: מינימליסטי על נייר קראפט
surface: a seamless matte paper sweep in a muted greyish sand-taupe (not yellow, not orange, not brown kraft): about #C9B8A6 at the top of the frame softly darkening to about #B3A390 at the bottom; smooth continuous curve from floor to wall with no horizon line, very fine paper grain; perfectly clean and empty - no crumbs, no flour, no seeds, no specks, no stains
lighting: single large soft diffused light from the front-left, like overcast north-window light; light falls off gently across the backdrop so the background has a subtle tonal gradient (lighter behind the top, slightly darker at the bottom and far right); a soft grounded contact shadow directly under the loaf plus a gentle soft shadow falling to the right; soft highlights that reveal crust texture; no hard light, no rim light, no heavy vignette
props: none at all - only the product alone on the clean paper; no crumbs, no flour, no plates, no boards, no cloth
camera: eye-level to slightly elevated (10-15 degrees) side view, 100mm lens at about f/4: the whole product is sharp from front to back while the backdrop falls into soft, creamy out-of-focus blur, creating depth and separation; the ENTIRE product fully visible and uncropped, centered, occupying about 35-45% of the frame width with generous even negative space on all sides; never a close-up, never cropped
mood: quiet, minimalist, editorial fine-bakery look; muted warm-neutral palette, soft film-like color grade with slightly lifted blacks; the background stays low-saturation greige while the bread keeps rich golden-brown crust color and texture; three-dimensional, tactile, gallery-like
extra: consistent series look, as if one of a grid of product photos shot on the same set in one session with identical background color and lighting

name: מאפייה כפרית
surface: a weathered dark oak table with a light dusting of flour, a folded natural linen cloth underneath
lighting: soft warm window light from the left side, gentle falloff into shadow on the right, subtle rim light that makes the crust glisten
props: a few scattered wheat stalks, a small ceramic bowl of coarse sea salt, a vintage bread knife, all slightly out of focus
camera: 45-degree angle, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field (f/2.8), the product sharp in the foreground
mood: warm, golden, inviting; rich browns and ambers; artisan and handmade

name: סקנדינבי בהיר
surface: a clean white Carrara marble countertop
lighting: bright diffused daylight from a large north-facing window, very soft shadows, airy high-key exposure
props: a light ceramic plate, a sprig of fresh herbs, a cup of coffee softly blurred in the background
camera: slightly elevated 30-degree angle, 50mm lens, moderate depth of field
mood: fresh, minimal, calm; whites, creams and soft beige; clean editorial look

name: דרמטי כהה
surface: a dark charcoal slate board on a deep black textured background
lighting: single hard-ish key light from behind and to the side (chiaroscuro), strong backlight that outlines the crust and reveals texture, deep controlled shadows
props: minimal: a dark linen napkin and a few crumbs, nothing distracting
camera: low 20-degree angle, 100mm macro lens, very shallow depth of field
mood: dramatic, luxurious, fine-dining; deep blacks with glowing golden crust

name: פטיסרי פריזאי
surface: a pale pastel pink tabletop with a white lace doily
lighting: soft even beauty lighting with a large softbox from the front-right, gentle highlights on glazes and sugar
props: a vintage porcelain cup and saucer, a few fresh berries, a small bouquet of flowers blurred in the background
camera: eye-level to 30-degree angle, 70mm lens, creamy bokeh
mood: elegant, delicate, romantic; pastel palette, polished and refined

name: רקע לבן לקטלוג
surface: a seamless pure white studio background (#FFFFFF) with a soft natural contact shadow under the product
lighting: professional three-point studio lighting, evenly lit, crisp detail, no color cast
camera: straight-on product shot, 100mm lens, everything in sharp focus, product centered with generous margins
mood: clean, commercial, e-commerce ready; true-to-life colors
